title: Andrographolide Suppresses Influenza A Virus-induced Pyroptosis via PI3K/AKT-mediated Caspase-3/GSDME Inactivation
author: Wen Yang
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Euthanize mice and collect lungs
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice on day 4 post‑infection and immediately harvest lung tissues.

steps.title: Extract total RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Homogenize the collected lungs and extract total RNA using TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, catalog 15596018CN).

steps.title: Assess RNA integrity
steps.instruction: Measure RNA integrity; retain only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) greater than 7.0 for downstream library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: From high‑integrity RNA, synthesize second‑strand cDNA, then construct libraries using a heat‑labile uracil‑DNA glycosylase enzyme protocol (New England Biolabs) followed by PCR amplification; select fragments of 300 ± 50 bp for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Library construction with heat‑labile uracil‑DNA glycosylase (NEB)

steps.title: Sequence and align reads
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries and align the reads to the Mus musculus reference genome.

steps.title: Quantify gene expression
steps.instruction: Quantify expression levels as fragments per kilobase of transcript per million mapped reads (FPKM).

steps.title: Differential expression analysis
steps.instruction: Perform differential expression analysis using the edgeR package with thresholds set at absolute fold change > 2 and a p‑value (as specified in the original text).
